findings.evidence: 'In every supplied-log reply, end with one line on reading results: exit 0 the `file` path in the JSON line, exit 2 the `missing` flags or bad value, exit 1 the file exists (ask before `--overwrite`), exit 3 an I/O failure'. The supplied log already shows the outcome, so explaining the other exit codes every time does nothing for the user. The line reads as if written to satisfy the script-bug-file eval assertion 'Says how to read the result'.
findings.fix: Tie the line to its purpose: 'When the logged exit is not 0, end with the remedy for that exit code', then narrow the eval assertion to match. Or remove the line and record the removal with a row in docs/audit/recovery/qa-test-planner/record.md

findings.evidence: '## 7.
